similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic Parthenon temple on the Acropolis. It features a multi-tiered stone base, a complete peristyle of columns (using cylinder arrays) on all four sides to ensure 360-degree completeness, internal cella walls, and a classical pediment roof structure using wedge shapes. The warm golden-orange lighting from the photo is captured via the accentHex and brightHex tones, while the weathered marble is represented by the facade and roof tones. All parts are tightly integrated with no gaps.
